neverPool: Three separate books on two platforms. A combined total describes none of them and hides which one is losing.

smartEntry.scope: SmartEntry engine and its own executors. Not the chart EA, not TradingView.
smartEntry.perBoxWarning: This is THIS BOX'S journal. The other box keeps its own and they do not overlap - neither machine holds the fleet's complete record.

eaCrt.scope: The CRT chart EA, by its own magics. Separate from SmartEntry by design.
eaCrt.note: preFix is v3.51 and its twin, 2026-07-05..07-15, trailing stop ON. current is v3.55/56 with the trail OFF. Never summed: the fixed build must not be averaged into a loss it did not cause.

tradingViewPaper.scope: A separate TradingView paper account. Invisible to /api/mt5/positions and to the trade ledger - both are fed from MT5.

crossCheck.detail: balance history sums to the account's own Realized PnL

note: Read-only. A book that could not be read is null, never zero.
